 Leturalma 2027 turns ten with Rozalén, Los Delinqüentes, SFDK and Rodrigo Cuevas: dates, line-up and passes
 Press release 
 Redacción ModoFestival · Editor: Clara Belmonte 
 19 Nov 2026, 20:51 
 A 3-minute read 
 Leturalma 
 Follow us on Google 
 In short
 Leturalma 2027 will run from Thursday 15 to Saturday 17 July in Letur (Albacete) : it is the festival's tenth edition, headlined by Rozalén, with a surprise artist yet to be announced. 
 According to the festival, Rozalén will play her only concert of 2027 in Letur : the singer from Albacete is the driving force behind the festival and presented the line-up in Madrid alongside Jordi Évole. 
 Los Delinqüentes, SFDK, Rodrigo Cuevas and Xoel López lead the rest of the first announcement , along with Seguridad Social, Travis Birds, Tanxugueiras and Sons of Aguirre & Scila. 
 The general three-day pass costs €60, plus €6 in fees , and is already on sale on Ticketvip, together with camping and the camper area. 
 Leturalma has announced the line-up for its tenth edition . The festival in Letur (Albacete) will take place from Thursday 15 to Saturday 17 July 2027 , with Rozalén as headliner and Los Delinqüentes , SFDK , Rodrigo Cuevas , Seguridad Social , Travis Birds , Xoel López , Tanxugueiras and Sons of Aguirre & Scila in the first announcement, unveiled this Thursday in Madrid.

 Letur Alma 2027

 Tickets 
 Disponibles 
 Leturalma 2027 line-up: the first names
 The presentation took place at the Galileo Galilei venue in Madrid, hosted by Rozalén and Jordi Évole . These are the main names in the announcement:
 Rozalén , who tops the bill.
 Los Delinqüentes , as part of the extension of their 2027 reunion tour .
 SFDK , on their comeback tour, which also takes them to Icónica Sevilla Fest 2027 .
 Rodrigo Cuevas , with the show for his album La Belleza .
 Seguridad Social , who are celebrating 45 years together.
 Travis Birds .
 Xoel López , with the Oniria Popular tour.
 Tanxugueiras .
 Sons of Aguirre & Scila , who are presenting their new album, Un día en la URSS .
 The festival will complete the line-up with a surprise artist to be announced later. The organisers have not yet released the day-by-day schedule.
 The poster for the tenth edition of Leturalma. Image: Leturalma. As well as the main acts, Cobardes , María Terremoto , Bewis de la Rosa , De Rancho and Aguacate y Mango will also perform. The programme includes family shows such as Los Niños de los Ojos Rojos, La Banda de Ases, Los Piratas: El Regreso and Greis's family rave, plus DJ sets spread across the site and various spots around the village.
 Rozalén and her only concert of 2027
 Rozalén is the driving force behind Leturalma and, according to the organisers, the Letur concert will be the only one she plays in 2027 . The organisers describe it as a celebration of ten years of a festival that sees culture as a tool against depopulation in the Sierra del Segura.
 The singer closed the Madrid presentation with a performance alongside Ismael Guijarro. This line-up follows a ninth edition featuring Siloé, Camela, OBK and Sanguijuelas del Guadiana, in which Arde Bogotá were the surprise artist .
 Tickets for Leturalma 2027: passes and camping
 Official sales are on Ticketvip , linked from the festival's website. For now, only three-day passes are available:
 General pass : €60, plus €6 in booking fees.
 Pass for children aged 6 to 15 and pass for over-65s : €50, plus €5 in fees.
 Leturcamping : €31 per person, plus €3.10 in fees. A festival pass is also required.
 Camper area : €45 per vehicle, plus €4.50 in fees.
 Children under 6 go free. Those aged 6 to 15 need a ticket, a signed form and must be accompanied by their father, mother or guardian; 16- and 17-year-olds can attend on their own but must also hand in the form. The concert site is at Letur's football ground , and Ticketvip also sells glamping tents, which do not include festival entry.
 All the practical information for this edition is on the Leturalma page .
